UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private user account profile, OTP verification metadata, access status, and cloud sync preferences stored under /users/{userId}.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

displayName.description: User display name from Google account.

role.description: Access role ('admin' for developer console, 'user' for standard app users).

otpVerifiedAt.description: ISO timestamp when Gmail verification code was last confirmed.

lastLoginAt.description: ISO timestamp of most recent sign-in session.

autoBackupEnabled.description: Whether edits automatically sync to Firestore when online.

autoRestoreEnabled.description: Whether newer cloud data automatically restores on sign-in.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated.

BudgetSheet.title: BudgetSheet
BudgetSheet.description: Monthly Philippine Peso budget and payroll spreadsheet document stored natively as Firestore maps.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the sheet owner.

rowOrder.description: Ordered list of row IDs in the sheet.

salaryBreakdown.description: Monthly and 15th cutoff salary breakdown map.

rows.description: Map of row states keyed by rowId.

clientUpdatedAt.description: Client ISO timestamp for merge/conflict comparison.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when sheet was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when sheet was last updated.

CloudBackup.title: CloudBackup
CloudBackup.description: Timestamped full workbook snapshot saved by the user to Firestore.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the backup owner.

deviceInfo.description: Platform or browser that created the snapshot.

monthsCount.description: Total number of monthly sheets in the snapshot.

data.description: Native map of MonthData objects keyed by monthId.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when snapshot was saved.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile, access approval status, and sync preferences for the authenticated Google user.

/users/{userId}/sheets/{monthId}.description: Real-time synced monthly budget sheets owned by the user.

/users/{userId}/backups/{backupId}.description: Timestamped cloud backup snapshots owned by the user.
